answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and commits to an epoch polynomial. Messages carry zero-knowledge proofs and Shamir shares tied to a rate-limit nullifier; reusing that nullifier at distinct points lets observers reconstruct the identity’s private secret and submit equivocation evidence for immediate collateral slashing. Timber, juniper, and jade may name epoch domains, but Sybil resistance comes from costly identities and publicly verifiable duplicate proofs.
